重點文章.標題: Low serum testosterone concentrations predict incident frailty in men with HIV.
重點文章.期刊: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism
重點文章.中文摘要:
【研究目的】本世代研究旨在探討To evaluate the associations of free T, total T, and sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG) with incident frailty among MWH.

【研究方法】Three hundred six nonfrail MWH (129 robust and 177 prefrail) with longitudinal frailty assessments from the Multicenter AIDS Cohort Study and Women's Interagency HIV Study Combined Cohort Study were enrolled. Incident frailty defined using the Fried frailty phenotype.

【主要結果】Over a mean follow-up of 9.0 years, low free T (<54 pg/mL) and low total T (<300 ng/dL) were associated with higher risk of incident frailty compared with higher concentrations (hazard ratio [HR]: 2.49, 95% CI: 1.21-5.11; HR: 3.31, 95% CI: 1.26-8.68, respectively).

【結論】Low T levels predict incident frailty in MWH. Assessment of androgen status may help identify men at increased frailty risk. Further investigations are warranted to assess the role of T therapy in frailty prevention.

結構化摘要.目的: To evaluate the associations of free T, total T, and sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG) with incident frailty among MWH.
結構化摘要.方法: Three hundred six nonfrail MWH (129 robust and 177 prefrail) with longitudinal frailty assessments from the Multicenter AIDS Cohort Study and Women's Interagency HIV Study Combined Cohort Study were enrolled. Incident frailty defined using the Fried frailty phenotype. Free T, total T, and SHBG were measured, with free T assessed by equilibrium dialysis. Marginal structural models were used to estimate associations with frailty outcomes while accounting for time and related covariates.
結構化摘要.結果: Over a mean follow-up of 9.0 years, low free T (<54 pg/mL) and low total T (<300 ng/dL) were associated with higher risk of incident frailty compared with higher concentrations (hazard ratio [HR]: 2.49, 95% CI: 1.21-5.11; HR: 3.31, 95% CI: 1.26-8.68, respectively). Sex hormone-binding globulin concentrations were not consistently associated with frailty outcomes.
結構化摘要.結論: Low T levels predict incident frailty in MWH. Assessment of androgen status may help identify men at increased frailty risk. Further investigations are warranted to assess the role of T therapy in frailty prevention.

【研究目的】本研究旨在探討To evaluate the efficacy and safety of rituximab (RTX) combined with low-dose, short-course glucocorticoids (GC) in adults with newly diagnosed minimal change disease (MCD).

【研究方法】We retrospectively analyzed 45 adults with newly diagnosed MCD. The RTX group (n=20) received RTX (1 g on days 1 and 15) plus low-dose methylprednisolone (0.25-0.30 mg/kg/day for 3 months). The GC group (n=25) received standard full-dose GCs.

【主要結果】Baseline characteristics were similar. Complete remission (CR) rates were comparable (95% vs. 92%, P>0.05). The relapse rate within 12 months was significantly lower in the RTX group (15% vs. 56%, P=0.004).

結構化摘要.方法: We retrospectively analyzed 45 adults with newly diagnosed MCD. The RTX group (n=20) received RTX (1 g on days 1 and 15) plus low-dose methylprednisolone (0.25-0.30 mg/kg/day for 3 months). The GC group (n=25) received standard full-dose GCs. Remission rates, relapse rates within 12 months, laboratory parameters, and adverse events were compared.
結構化摘要.結果: Baseline characteristics were similar. Complete remission (CR) rates were comparable (95% vs. 92%, P>0.05). The relapse rate within 12 months was significantly lower in the RTX group (15% vs. 56%, P=0.004). Serum albumin levels and lipid profiles improved in both groups; renal function remained stable. 結構化摘要.結論: This RTX-based regimen may be a promising first-line alternative for selected patients with newly diagnosed MCD.

PICO.O_結果: graft loss; secondary endpoints were overall survival, acute rejection, and kidney function

重點文章.中文摘要:
【研究目的】本世代研究旨在探討ed to evaluate the impact of donor-recipient height mismatch on short- and long-term outcomes in pediatric kidney transplant recipients.

【研究方法】We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients (SRTR), including pediatric kidney transplant recipients between 2010 and 2020. The primary endpoint was graft loss; secondary endpoints were overall survival, acute rejection, and kidney function.

【主要結果】A total of 5321 patients were included (mean age 10.4 ± 5.2 years). A higher donor to recipient height ratio was associated with an increased risk of graft loss (HR 1.90; 95% CI 1.09-3.30; p = 0.023).

【結論】Donor-recipient height mismatch increases the risk of graft loss in children; but this adverse effect diminished with recipient age. While height matching should be prioritized in early childhood, flexible allocation, including the use of larger adult living donor organs, remains a sound clinical st...

結構化摘要.背景: AND HYPOTHESIS: The impact of kidney size mismatch on outcomes after pediatric kidney transplantation remains poorly understood. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of donor-recipient height mismatch on short- and long-term outcomes in pediatric kidney transplant recipients.
結構化摘要.方法: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients (SRTR), including pediatric kidney transplant recipients between 2010 and 2020. The primary endpoint was graft loss; secondary endpoints were overall survival, acute rejection, and kidney function. Hazard ratios were calculated using Fine and Gray's proportional subdistribution hazards models.
結構化摘要.結果: A total of 5321 patients were included (mean age 10.4 ± 5.2 years). A higher donor to recipient height ratio was associated with an increased risk of graft loss (HR 1.90; 95% CI 1.09-3.30; p = 0.023). However, this adverse effect decreased with increasing recipient age (interaction age × HD/Rr: HR 0.93; 95% CI 0.88-0.99; p = 0.016). No significant differences were observed regarding acute rejection or overall survival.
結構化摘要.結論: Donor-recipient height mismatch increases the risk of graft loss in children; but this adverse effect diminished with recipient age. While height matching should be prioritized in early childhood, flexible allocation, including the use of larger adult living donor organs, remains a sound clinical strategy in children with chronic kidney disease stage 5, as the benefits of transplantation outweigh the risk of size mismatch.
